notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 64-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.53, bnp 1479, creatinine 1.1, hemoglobin 12.8, platelets 241, sodium 140, wbc 9.2; vitals dbp 67-73, heart_rate 83-87, map 84-89, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 117-124, spo2 96-97, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Furosemide 40 mg IV; Transthoracic echo: LVEF 26%, global hypokinesis
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. CHF.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.08, hemoglobin 12.9, platelets 240, sodium 140, wbc 9.2; vitals dbp 68-72, heart_rate 83-89, map 85-88, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 118-121, spo2 96-98, temp 36.6-36.9
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Furosemide 40 mg IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. CHF. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 64-year-old female, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. CHF. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
